findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. The extra `];` immediately after the SCREENS declaration makes app.js syntactically invalid. shell.html:9 loads this file as the board's entry module, so the browser cannot initialize any screen, fetch the snapshot or attach navigation handlers. Every board visit is blocked. Remove the duplicate closing bracket.
